text: 华厦眼科公告，实际控制人、董事长兼总经理苏庆灿先生计划自2026年9月2日至2026年12月1日，通过集中竞价方式增持公司股份，增持金额不低于人民币3000万元。本次增持计划不设置价格区间，资金来源为自有资金。
text_en: Huaxia Eye Hospital announced that its actual controller, chairman and general manager Su Qingcan plans to increase his shareholding via centralized bidding from September 2 to December 1, 2026, with total additions of no less than RMB 30 million. The plan has no price range and will be funded by his own funds.
